description: Cursor Agent host. Live spawn is Cursor Task, local or cloud (CURSOR.md, docs/host-cursor.md). Model IDs are the Task-tool slugs this host accepts as of 2026-09-14, not provider API names. inherit is forbidden.

cheap.notes: Cursor's fast Composer. Scoot and other one-breath errands.

standard.notes: Utility roles and straightforward prompt/document work. Same slug as cheap until Cursor exposes a non-fast Composer Task id.

strong.notes: Architecture, critique, backend, and frontend first pass.

frontier.notes: Final gates, subtle design/code risk, or high-stakes reviews. Pass this Task slug explicitly; do not inherit.

escalated.notes: Repeated failure, hard adjudication, or explicit human request. Highest Task slug this host currently exposes.
